verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is an incorporation service. A sandbox or test environment is a plausible question for a SaaS platform, so the axis applies. However, no evidence item describes an Atlas sandbox, test mode, or isolated non-production environment. The items cover incorporation, EIN and 83(b) filings, equity, banking and perks, and the general Stripe llms.txt probe says nothing about an Atlas sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
